plugins.name: soc
plugins.description: Exabeam Agentic SOC plugin (Preview) — the socxen SOC skill suite for Exabeam New-Scale, for Claude Code and OpenAI Codex. Three skills over one guarded Exabeam MCP bridge: soc-investigate (alert/case investigation to a written verdict), triage-cases (prioritise the open queue), rule-tuning (find noisy detection rules). Containment is recommended for a human; dismiss/close is held behind the host agent's approval gate. Pinned build of socxen 0.8.5 (2026-08-30); upstream: open-agent-ai-security/socxen.
